trim.config.title: Trim
trim.config.apiUrl: Trim Cloud API base URL (required; no default host)
trim.config.httpTimeoutSec: HTTP timeout (seconds) for ide-chrome and event flush. Allowed range is enforced from Trim cloud site_messages (IDE_HTTP_TIMEOUT_*), not invented in the extension runtime.
trim.config.trackDocumentEdits: Heuristic LOC tracking from multi-line inserts/deletes (labeled mode=ide)
trim.config.minLines: Minimum AI-edited lines before an event is queued
trim.config.autoStartWithIde: Local override for starting Trim proxy when this IDE opens: follow (cloud preference), on, or off. Does not start Deep/compress.
trim.config.workspaceId: Optional Trim workspace UUID. When set, cloud API calls send X-Workspace-Id so shared workspace credits apply (leave empty for personal quota).
trim.walkthrough.title: Get started with Trim IDE
trim.walkthrough.description: Connect this editor to Trim Cloud, register this IDE device, and keep the local Fast Mode proxy ready.
trim.walkthrough.installCli.title: Install the Trim CLI
trim.walkthrough.installCli.description:
The extension starts ``trim start`` on your PATH when Always-on is enabled.

macOS/Linux: ``curl -fsSL https://use-trim.com/install.sh | sh``

Windows: ``irm https://use-trim.com/install.ps1 | iex``

Docs: [Installation](https://use-trim.com/docs/installation)
trim.walkthrough.apiUrl.title: Set Trim API URL
trim.walkthrough.apiUrl.description:
Open Settings and set **Trim: Api Url** to your API origin (hosted: ``https://api.use-trim.com``).

Leave empty to keep the extension inactive (fail-closed).

[Open Trim: Api Url](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22trim.apiUrl%22%5D)
trim.walkthrough.hardware.title: Register this IDE hardware ID
trim.walkthrough.hardware.description:
IDE device IDs differ from the CLI fingerprint - do not paste a ``trim login`` id here.

1. Run **Trim: Copy Hardware ID** (clipboard).
2. Dashboard → Settings → API keys → **Register device** → paste → agent **IDE**.

[Copy Hardware ID](command:trim.copyHardwareId)

Docs: [Device binding](https://use-trim.com/docs/security/device-binding)
trim.walkthrough.apiKey.title: Store your Trim API key
trim.walkthrough.apiKey.description:
Create a **Trim** key under Dashboard → Settings → API keys (not your OpenAI/Anthropic/Google provider key).

Then run **Trim: Set API Key**. Stored in editor Secret Storage - never in ``settings.json``.

[Set API Key](command:trim.setApiKey)

Privacy: [https://use-trim.com/privacy](https://use-trim.com/privacy)
trim.walkthrough.baseUrl.title: Point chat at the local proxy
trim.walkthrough.baseUrl.description:
This extension is not the compressor. Telemetry alone does not save tokens.

Point Cursor Override / Continue ``apiBase`` / VS Code Custom Endpoint at Trim ``…/v1`` (or full ``…/v1/chat/completions`` for Custom Endpoint). Claude Code: ``ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`` = listen origin only (no ``/v1``).

[Connect any IDE](https://use-trim.com/docs/ide/connect) · [Continue setup](https://use-trim.com/docs/ide/continue) · [VS Code setup](https://use-trim.com/docs/ide/vscode)
